_status: PROFILING-ONLY config, not a real drug test. Small enough (single dose, runs=4, sim_time_ms=2000 -> 50,000 steps) to finish in well under a minute so nsys's own overhead doesn't dominate, but long enough (thousands of steps) to give a representative kernel-time distribution for fusedBatchedStepKernel. Uses the same neuron_count/connectivity/receptor stack as every other --dose-eval run, so whatever nsys shows here generalizes to the real sweeps.
